data.title: Italy says it backs Germany joining next-generation fighter jet project
data.description:
Italy said on Saturday it fully supported Germany's participation in the Global Combat Air Programme to develop a next-generation fighter jet, rejecting media reports that Rome had sought to block Berlin from joining.

The government said in a statement that a Financial Times report suggesting it had opposed Germany's entry was "entirely misleading" and did not reflect Rome's longstanding position.

Italy said it had always been willing to welcome Germany into GCAP and had proposed that Berlin initially join on an observer-only basis to facilitate information-sharing and speed its path towards full membership.

Rome said the proposal was designed to accelerate Germany's involvement while protecting the programme's timetable and progress, and was not intended to restrict Berlin's future role.

Italy reiterated its position during the latest GCAP videoconference involving the programme's three partner nations, it said in the statement, adding that it viewed German participation as "a positive opportunity".

GCAP brings together Italy, Britain and Japan to develop a next-generation fighter aircraft by 2035, with Leonardo , BAE Systems and Japan's Mitsubishi Heavy Industries leading the industrial effort.

data.title: Elon Musk, Trump, Kress, Nvidia’s Board On Jensen Huang’s Exit: Mag 7 Voices This Week
data.description:
Key points:
  • Elon Musk said it would be an honor to have Huang at Tesla or SpaceX, but made no formal offer or specified a potential role.
  • President Donald Trump praised Huang and suggested former Apple CEO Tim Cook could replace him.
  • Trump also stated that the FBI was investigating Huang’s relationship involving the woman allegedly suspected of being a Chinese spy.

At the start of the week, Nvidia’s (NVDA) board publicly expressed “absolute confidence in Jensen and his leadership team.” Four days later, CEO Jensen Huang had resigned, effective immediately, leaving the company facing an unexpected leadership transition just days before its next earnings report.

Nvidia said Huang stepped down as president, CEO, and board member. Chief Financial Officer Colette Kress will serve as interim CEO while the board searches for a permanent replacement. The company is scheduled to report third-quarter results next Tuesday.

The abrupt departure prompted reactions from across the board, including Tesla (TSLA) and SpaceX (SPCX) CEO Elon Musk and President Donald Trump. Their comments ranged from Musk suggesting it would be an honor to bring Huang to his companies to Trump publicly floating former Apple CEO Tim Cook as a possible successor.

Nvidia’s Board: From ‘Confidence In Jensen’ To ‘Immeasurable Contributions’

“The Board has confidence in Jensen and his leadership team.”

– Nvidia Board Statement (November 8, 2026)

Nvidia’s board issued the above statement on Sunday while announcing an independent investigation into reports that Huang had been targeted by a foreign intelligence effort. It also said it had “no reason to believe” that national security or Nvidia’s confidential information had been compromised.

“Immeasurable contributions to the company and the industry.”

– Nvidia Board Statement (November 12, 2026)

Four days later, the board’s tone had shifted. Its announcement of Huang’s departure thanked him for his “immeasurable contributions to the company and the industry,” but offered no reason for his resignation and included no statement from Huang.

According to the company’s SEC filing, the board accepted Huang’s resignation on Nov. 11. Kress will retain her CFO responsibilities while serving as interim CEO. The board said it will consider both internal and external candidates in its search for a permanent chief executive.

This week, NVDA stock logged its longest weekly losing streak since 2012, with its market capitalization sinking by over $1.6 trillion. On Stocktwits, retail sentiment around Nvidia trended in the ‘extremely bullish’ territory over the past week, with chatter rising to ‘extremely high’ from ‘high’ levels. Platform data showed an uptick of nearly 400% in message volume over the last seven days.

Colette Kress, Harvey Jones: ‘The Extraordinary Foundation Jensen Created’

“The Board has full confidence in Colette and the leadership team.”

Harvey Jones, board chair, Nvidia

Kress struck a continuity-focused tone in her statement, emphasizing the foundation Huang had built during his 33 years at the company.

The board also expressed confidence in Kress and the existing leadership team, signaling that it does not expect the change at the top to disrupt the company's day-to-day operations or longer-term plans.

“Committed to building on the extraordinary foundation Jensen created over the last 33 years.”

– Colette Kress, interim CEO and CFO, Nvidia

The board also announced Harvey Jones, former CEO of Synopsys, as the first chair in Nvidia’s history. He has served on the board since 1993. Jones said the company expects its operations, customer commitments and product roadmap to continue without interruption.

Jensen Huang: An Apology And A Phone Call

“I owe my family and all of you an apology.”

– Jensen Huang, in a message to Nvidia employees (Nov. 8, 2026)

Huang’s message to employees on Sunday set the stage for the events that followed. In it, he acknowledged being unfaithful to his wife, without identifying the woman involved.

Reports linked the relationship to Alice Huang, a former executive at Nvidia customer Megaspeed. U.S. intelligence reportedly suspects her of working for China. Alice Huang is not related to Jensen Huang, and the reports did not allege that he knowingly assisted Chinese intelligence.

The New York Times later reported a second relationship involving an Nvidia employee who reported to Huang. By Thursday afternoon, Reuters reported that a third alleged relationship with another employee may also be under scrutiny.

Huang had not made a public statement after the board announced his resignation.

ElonMusk Thinks It Would ‘Be An Honor’ To Have Huang At SpaceX, Tesla

“That would be an honor.”

– Elon Musk, CEO, Tesla and SpaceX

Musk made the above comment in response to a post by ZeroHedge, which said, “Elon please hire Jensen.” He replied roughly two hours later, around the time Nvidia’s board was reportedly in a meeting deciding Huang’s fate.

Musk did not specify what role Huang might take at either company, and his response did not amount to a formal job offer.

SpaceX has committed to a $40-billion lease of Nvidia equipment, adding another dimension to the relationship between the companies.

On Stocktwits, retail sentiment around TSLA stock flipped to ‘bullish’ from ‘extremely bearish’ over the past week, while sentiment around SPCX stock dipped to ‘neutral’ from the ‘bullish’ zone.

Donald Trump Wants Tim Cook To Take Over For Huang

“I really believe him.”

– President Donald Trump, on his Monday call with Huang

Trump said he had spoken with Huang on the phone and that the Nvidia CEO told him he had no idea the woman in question was a spy.

Following Huang’s resignation, Trump took to Truth Social and suggested that former Apple CEO Tim Cook should replace him.

“A Legend replaces a Legend!”

– President Donald Trump, on Truth Social

Trump wrote that “there is only one man to take his place,” naming Cook, who stepped down as Apple’s CEO in September and now serves as executive chairman.

“It would be a betrayal of Apple or seen as such,” said CNBC’s John Fortt, citing why Cook stepping in for Huang may not work. “I've talked to Jensen about Apple a few times over the years, and I always got kind of a chilly reception to any comparison between Nvidia and Apple,” he added, stating that Apple and Nvidia's cultures are “not compatible.”

“That’s so sad to see that happen.”

– President Donald Trump

Trump also described the situation as a “horrible thing,” CBS reported. Earlier in the week, he said the FBI was investigating the relationship between Huang and the woman allegedly suspected of being a Chinese spy.

While Musk and Trump weighed in publicly on Huang’s departure, other major technology leaders have so far remained silent. Amazon (AMZN) CEO Andy Jassy and the heads of the other Magnificent Seven companies had not publicly commented on the Nvidia leadership shake-up at the time of writing.

data.title: Fino Payments Bank Names Banking Veteran Pratap Singh As CEO
data.description:
The banking veteran brings over 29 years of experience across retail banking, SME banking and digital transformation

Fino Payments Bank has received approval from the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) to appoint Pratap Singh as its Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer (MD & CEO) for a three-year term.The appointment will take effect from 27 November 2026, or the date Singh takes charge, whichever is earlier, subject to shareholder approval, the bank said in a regulatory filing on Friday.

The bank's board will take the necessary steps to complete the appointment process, following the RBI's clearance.

Singh's appointment comes as the bank transitions from its interim leadership arrangement. Ketan Merchant, the bank's Chief Financial Officer (CFO), is currently serving as interim CEO.Merchant took over the interim responsibility following the arrest of former MD and CEO Rishi Gupta in February over alleged violations of laws relating to the Goods and Services Tax (GST).

The Directorate General of GST Intelligence (DGGI) arrested Gupta over allegations that shell companies and payment aggregators were used to channel funds generated through online money gaming. The allegations remain subject to the relevant legal proceedings.

Banking Veteran To Lead Fino

Singh brings more than 29 years of experience in the banking sector across India and the United Kingdom. His professional experience spans retail banking, small and medium enterprise (SME) banking, liabilities, digital transformation, branch-led profitability and operating model redesign.He has also worked on building and transforming mid-sized banking businesses into liability-rich, customer-centric and higher-growth franchises.

His appointment marks a leadership transition for Fino Payments Bank as it prepares to move from its interim management arrangement to a new three-year leadership term.

data.title: Record Exports Fail To Curb India’s $57 Bn CAD Risk
data.description:
India current account deficit may widen to $57 billion in FY27 as higher oil prices and domestic demand push imports above exports, ICICI Bank estimates

India’s current account deficit (CAD) is expected to widen to USD 57 billion, or 1.4 per cent of gross domestic product (GDP), in FY27 as strong domestic demand and elevated oil prices keep imports high despite robust export growth, according to an ICICI Bank report released on November 14.

The bank expects India's merchandise trade deficit to reach USD 380 billion during the financial year, compared with its earlier estimate of USD 388 billion. It said goods exports have grown 22 per cent year-on-year so far in FY27, while imports have risen 16 per cent, driven by stronger domestic demand and higher oil prices.

Record Exports Fail to Offset Import Surge

India's merchandise trade deficit widened to nearly USD 40 billion in October, its highest level in 12 months, from USD 30.2 billion in September. The expansion was driven by an oil deficit of USD 14 billion and a non-oil, non-gold deficit of USD 20 billion.

Goods exports rose 45 per cent year-on-year to a record USD 49 billion in October, supported by a 140 per cent jump in oil shipments and 33 per cent growth in non-oil exports. However, merchandise imports increased 17 per cent to a record USD 89 billion, with oil imports rising 54 per cent and non-oil, non-gold imports growing 29 per cent.

Services and Remittances Offer Support

ICICI Bank expects services exports to register moderate growth amid softer demand linked to artificial intelligence-related disruptions, while remittances are likely to remain steady. Net services exports rose 13 per cent year-on-year to USD 19.8 billion in October. The bank said recent foreign portfolio investment (FPI) inflows have improved the outlook for the rupee. India received USD 8.8 billion in FPI inflows in November so far, following a period of outflows.

The bank remains more constructive on the rupee, supported by recent RBI measures and investment flows, while cautioning that any escalation in the West Asia conflict could pose a near-term risk. India's balance of payments remained in surplus during the first half of FY27, supported by strong banking capital inflows, including deposits under the FCNR scheme.

data.title: Nature Trails expands Maharashtra portfolio with Dodamarg resort
data.description:
Thomas Cook (India) Limited’s experiential hospitality brand, Nature Trails, has expanded its resort network to seven properties with the addition of Nature Trails INA Resort in Dodamarg, Maharashtra. The property marks the brand’s fourth resort in the state and strengthens its presence across Maharashtra’s nature-led destinations.

Spread across three acres in Ker, Dodamarg, the resort is located close to North Goa and offers nature-led stays, outdoor recreation and leisure experiences. Its accommodation options include Vana Forest View Rooms, Ira Cottages and Arka Cottages, catering to families, couples and groups.

The resort’s recreational offerings include trekking, birdwatching, archery, treasure hunts and team games, along with an outdoor swimming pool. Dining is centred around Mitra, a multi-cuisine restaurant featuring Maharashtrian flavours, with both air-conditioned and open-air seating.

The property is approximately 40 km from Mopa Airport, around 30 km from Thivim Railway Station and 18 km from Dodamarg Bus Stand.

Mahesh Iyer, Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer, Thomas Cook (India) Limited, said, “The expansion of Nature Trails is aligned with our broader strategy of building a differentiated hospitality portfolio that responds to the growing opportunity in experiential and nature-led travel. We see significant potential in destinations beyond established leisure hubs, particularly those that offer opportunities to develop distinctive holiday experiences while contributing to the growth of emerging tourism markets. Our focus is on building a portfolio with a strong destination proposition, supported by the right hospitality infrastructure and operating model.

With the addition of our resort in Maharashtra’s Dodamarg, we are strengthening our presence in a strategically important leisure market while extending the Nature Trails brand into another destination with considerable potential. As we expand the portfolio, we will continue to evaluate opportunities that align with our long-term growth priorities, strengthen our geographic footprint and create sustainable value for the business.”

data.title: Yes Bank Denies $3.4 Mn Cyber Fraud, Seeks Retraction
data.description:
Yes Bank cyber fraud allegations involving a USD 3.4 million loss have been rejected by the lender, which denies any systems breach or financial loss

Yes Bank has strongly denied a report alleging that it suffered a cyber fraud loss of approximately USD 3.4 million, or Rs 32 crore, involving government accounts, asserting that its systems remained secure and no financial loss was incurred. In a clarification issued on November 13, the private sector lender termed the allegations factually incorrect and said they did not reflect the actual position.

A Financial Times Group publication, titled ‘India on High Alert After Alleged USD 3.4 Million Cyber Loss at Yes Bank’. The report alleged that the incident occurred towards the end of October 2026 and involved government accounts.

Bank Denies Systems Compromise

Yes Bank said its systems had not been compromised and no government accounts had been affected by the alleged incident. The lender also categorically denied incurring any financial loss in connection with the reported cyber fraud. The bank said the claims concerning its systems and financial exposure were inaccurate and could create unwarranted concerns among stakeholders.

Seeks Retraction Over Alleged Inaccuracies

Yes Bank said it had taken up the matter with the publication, highlighted what it described as factual inaccuracies and sought a retraction. The lender said the publication of incorrect information could be detrimental to its reputation and potentially undermine stakeholder confidence.

"YES BANK remains committed to upholding the highest standards of banking security, operational integrity and customer trust," the bank said in its statement. The clarification comes amid heightened concerns over cybersecurity risks across the financial services sector, particularly incidents involving banks and government-linked accounts. Yes Bank maintained that the alleged incident had not resulted in any compromise of its systems or financial losses.

data.title: RBI Fines Mobikwik Rs 9 Lakh Over PPI Violations, Fraud Delays
data.description:
RBI penalty on Mobikwik amounts to Rs 9 lakh for prepaid payment instrument violations and delayed fraud reporting, following a regulatory inspection

The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) has imposed a monetary penalty of Rs 9 lakh on One Mobikwik Systems Limited for non-compliance with regulatory directions governing prepaid payment instruments (PPIs) and fraud reporting. The penalty follows a statutory inspection covering the company’s operations between June 2025 and March 2026.

In an order dated November 6, 2026, the central bank said its supervisory assessment identified violations of specified regulatory requirements. The action was taken under Section 30(1), read with Section 26(6), of the Payment and Settlement Systems Act, 2007.

PPI Transfers Beyond Prescribed Limits

Following the inspection, RBI issued a notice to the company seeking an explanation for the identified non-compliance. After examining Mobikwik’s response, additional submissions and oral representations during a personal hearing, the regulator concluded that the charges were established.

RBI found that the company had permitted certain PPI holders to transfer funds to beneficiaries who were not pre-registered, beyond the prescribed limit. The finding relates to compliance with the central bank’s directions governing prepaid payment instruments.

Delayed Fraud Reporting

The regulator also found that Mobikwik had failed to report certain frauds within the stipulated timeline. The penalty covers deficiencies in both PPI-related compliance and fraud reporting obligations. RBI clarified that the action reflects regulatory compliance deficiencies and does not determine the validity of transactions or agreements between the company and its customers. It also said the penalty does not preclude further action against the company. The company disclosed receipt of the penalty order on November 13, 2026, in its regulatory filing to the stock exchanges.

data.title: SoftBank Sells 1.65% Stake In Meesho For Rs 1,885 Cr
data.description:
The Japanese investor offloads 7.64 crore shares through a block deal, reducing its affiliate's holding in the e-commerce company to 5.19 per cent

Japanese investor SoftBank Group has sold a 1.65 per cent stake in e-commerce company Meesho for Rs 1,885 crore, further reducing its holding in the Indian company.

SVF II Meerkat (DE) LLC, an affiliate of SoftBank, offloaded 7.64 crore shares in Bengaluru-based Meesho through a block deal on Friday, according to data from the National Stock Exchange (NSE).

The shares were sold at an average price of Rs 246.75 apiece, taking the total transaction value to Rs 1,885.17 crore. Following the sale, the affiliate's stake in Meesho declined to 5.19 per cent from 6.84 per cent.

Institutional Investors Buy Shares

The stake sale was picked up by a group of domestic and foreign institutional investors, with Paris-based financial services firm Societe Generale (SocGen) emerging as the largest buyer.

SocGen acquired more than 1.47 crore shares, equivalent to a 0.32 per cent stake in Meesho, for Rs 364.65 crore.

Domestic institutional participants included mutual funds managed by Motilal Oswal, HDFC, Edelweiss and Aditya Birla Sun Life, along with Bajaj Life Insurance.

Overseas investors included Morgan Stanley, Fidelity Investments, BNP Paribas, Goldman Sachs, Ghisallo Capital Management, William Blair Investment Management and Texas Municipal Retirement System.

The Singaporean government, Monetary Authority of Singapore and Norway's sovereign wealth fund, Government Pension Fund Global, also participated in the transaction.

Meesho shares rose 1.53 per cent to close at Rs 257.99 apiece on the NSE on Friday.

SoftBank Continues Portfolio Stake Sales

The latest transaction follows a series of stake sales by SoftBank in its Indian portfolio companies, particularly in the e-commerce and consumer technology sectors.

Earlier this month, the Japanese investor sold a 1.56 per cent stake in eyewear retailer Lenskart Solutions for Rs 1,896 crore. In September, it sold a 1.7 per cent stake in Meesho for Rs 1,650 crore.

SoftBank had also divested nearly 2.6 per cent of Lenskart for Rs 2,888 crore in August and a further 3.25 per cent stake for Rs 2,873 crore in June.

In January, the technology investor reduced its shareholding in electric two-wheeler manufacturer Ola Electric Mobility by 2.15 per cent, as part of its broader portfolio monetisation exercise in India.

data.title: India’s 10 Most Booked Emcees Of 2026
data.description:
From corporate conferences and award ceremonies to celebrity appearances, product launches and large-scale celebrations, these emcees bring their own styles and professional experience to India's live events industry

An emcee does much more than introduce speakers or announce the next performance. The role involves understanding the audience, maintaining the pace of an event, managing transitions and ensuring that the programme remains engaging. As India's live events industry continues to serve corporate, entertainment, wedding and experiential formats, professional hosts have become an important part of the event experience.

From television presenters and radio professionals to corporate hosts, performers and public speakers, the following list features ten emcees associated with India's live events industry, in the order provided.

Ritika Jhanji Jagtiani

Ritika Jhanji Jagtiani is a television presenter, broadcast media professional, live events anchor and public speaker. Based in Delhi, she has built her professional experience across television, digital media and live event hosting. Her background in broadcast journalism has also given her experience in presenting information, interviewing guests and engaging with audiences across different formats.

Jagtiani has worked with news and media organisations, including WION, Republic TV and NDTV, according to professional recommendations on her LinkedIn profile. Her work spans live news, lifestyle programming, digital content and live events. She is also associated with corporate hosting, public speaking and coaching.

Her professional profile highlights her ability to moderate discussions and interact with business leaders, policymakers and senior corporate executives. This experience is particularly relevant to conferences, leadership gatherings and business-focused events, where an emcee is expected to manage conversations while keeping the programme on schedule.

Jagtiani received the BW Applause Best Emcee of the Year honour in 2020. Her professional journey also includes experience in digital presentations and public-facing campaigns. With a background in broadcast media and live event hosting, she brings a combination of journalistic experience and stage presentation to the events space.

Ravin Kundu

Ravin Kundu is a Delhi-based television host, live event emcee, sports presenter, moderator and public speaker. His work covers corporate events, product launches, sporting events, college festivals, entertainment programmes and brand activations. His professional portfolio reflects experience across several event formats and industries.

Kundu's event portfolio lists more than 1,500 shows and over a decade of hosting experience. His assignments have included product launches for brands such as Lamborghini, Adidas, BMW and Harley-Davidson, as well as events featuring public figures and celebrities. His sports-related hosting work includes associations with Adidas football programmes, the Australian Open's ballkids initiative and other sporting events.

He has also hosted college festivals and entertainment properties, including events at institutions such as IIT Delhi and IIM Kolkata. His experience extends to corporate family days, team-building activities and virtual events.

Kundu's work has received recognition at the e4m Red Carpet Experiential Marketing Awards. At the 2025 edition, he was recognised in the Best Emcee Corporate Events (Male) and Best Male Emcee of the Year categories, according to the awards organiser. His experience across corporate, sports and entertainment formats places him among the active professional hosts in India's live events industry.

Emcee Ridima Wali

Ridima Wali is a professional emcee whose portfolio includes corporate events, product launches, award ceremonies and brand engagements. Her hosting style, as described in her professional profile, combines humour, spontaneity and audience interaction. She also places emphasis on researching the organisations and brands she represents on stage, particularly when hosting formal corporate programmes.

Her event portfolio includes assignments for the Retailers Association of India, where she has hosted multiple editions of its events. Other listed engagements include the Park Avenue deodorant launch featuring Farhan Akhtar and the MARD campaign, the Alembic Annual Achievers Awards in Dubai, the Micro Labs CMD Awards in Goa and a Raymond-KVIC press meet attended by Gautam Hari Singhania.

These assignments reflect her experience across corporate gatherings, industry events, product launches and international programmes. Hosting such events requires an understanding of the audience and the purpose of the occasion, along with the ability to maintain the flow of the programme.

Wali's professional profile also describes her approach to formal events as research-led, with an emphasis on incorporating information about the brand and its business impact into her stage interactions. This allows the hosting to remain connected to the subject of the event rather than relying only on entertainment and announcements.

Emcee Amar Prabhu

Amar Prabhu, professionally known as RJ Amar, is a radio jockey, corporate host, professional anchor, team-building expert and voice-over artist based in Bengaluru. His work covers corporate events, award nights, concerts, product launches, college programmes, training sessions and entertainment-led gatherings.

According to his professional website, Prabhu has more than 13 years of experience and has hosted over 2,000 shows in India and overseas. He describes himself as a multilingual anchor, with services extending beyond conventional event hosting to include audience engagement, team-building activities, voice-overs and customised content for corporate programmes.

His portfolio features assignments for organisations including Diageo, Tata AIG, ABB, CGI, HP and Juniper. He has also hosted corporate growth summits, college festivals and large-format gatherings. One of the events featured in his portfolio involved hosting a themed corporate gathering with an audience of more than 2,500 people.

Prabhu's work also includes creating customised monologues, rap performances and interactive activities for corporate audiences. These formats allow him to combine hosting with entertainment and audience participation. His experience across radio, live events and voice work gives him exposure to different forms of communication, making his professional portfolio extend beyond stage announcements and programme introductions.

Emcee Pritie Kathpaal

Pritie Kathpaal is an anchor, actress, television host and performer whose work spans corporate events, entertainment programmes and weddings. She began hosting events in 2010 and has since developed a professional presence across live entertainment and television. She studied at National College of Bandra and also maintains an active presence on social media, where she shares updates from her professional assignments and appearances.

Kathpaal's portfolio includes corporate events for organisations such as the Adani Group. Her professional profile states that she has hosted more than 2,000 corporate shows, entertainment events and weddings across over 40 countries. Her international assignments have given her exposure to different audiences and event formats.

Her television experience includes appearances on NDTV Good Times' Fast & the Gorgeous and Channel V's Adam vs Madam. She has also hosted entertainment properties, including the WOW Awards, Filmfare Glamour & Style Awards and MTV Girls Night Out. Her work at the Filmfare Glamour & Style Awards has included red-carpet hosting and celebrity interactions.

In 2022, Kathpaal received the Events Than Best Anchor Award and the EMF Global Best Anchor Award. She also received recognition at the EMF Awards in 2023. Her career brings together television, acting and live event hosting, with a portfolio spanning corporate and entertainment-led assignments.

Emcee Pooja Kanwal Mahtani

Pooja Kanwal Mahtani is an actress, television presenter, corporate emcee and motivational speaker based in Mumbai. Her professional journey began in acting, with work across Hindi television and films, before she expanded into television presenting and live event hosting.

Her acting credits include the Hindi film Uuf Kya Jaadoo Mohabbat Hai, the Kannada films Seven O' Clock and Tirupathi, and television shows such as Sasural Genda Phool and Palampur Express. She also appeared in the television series Na Bole Tum Na Maine Kuchh Kaha. Her experience in front of the camera has been complemented by work as a television host and presenter.

In television, Mahtani has hosted and presented programmes associated with CNBC, including LIME, as well as food and entertainment formats. She has also worked with Aaj Tak and India Today Group. Her live-event portfolio includes corporate and wedding hosting, with assignments requiring her to engage audiences across formal and entertainment-led settings.

Mahtani has also pursued dance training across different styles, including jazz and contemporary dance. Her professional profile describes her as a host who combines acting, presentation and motivational speaking. This mix of experience gives her a background across television, entertainment and corporate events.

Khyati Kava

Khyati Kava is an award-winning emcee, stage presenter, corporate trainer, public speaker and engagement consultant. Her professional work includes corporate conferences, product launches, award ceremonies, luxury events and industry gatherings. Based in Mumbai, she has developed a profile in live event hosting as well as radio and television.

Kava's professional biography states that she has hosted more than 1,000 shows across over 25 countries. Her portfolio includes brand launches and corporate events for organisations such as Tata, Audi, Samsung and Asian Paints. She has also hosted conferences and industry gatherings, including the MICE India and Luxury Travel Congress.

Her work has extended to virtual and hybrid events, including the launch of the Generic Aadhaar app. She has also appeared in television and radio formats and has shared screen space with actors including Ranbir Kapoor, Aishwarya Rai Bachchan, Kajol and Ranveer Singh, according to her professional profile.

Kava holds a Bachelor's degree in Mass Media and a postgraduate diploma in Advertising and Public Relations. She is also a certified Zumba instructor and contemporary doodle artist. At the e4m Red Carpet Experiential Marketing Awards 2025, she received the Best Female Emcee of the Year recognition. Her work combines stage presentation with corporate communication and audience engagement.

Anurima Mitra

Anurima Mitra is a Kolkata-based emcee, television anchor, scriptwriter, translator, actor and singer. Her professional work covers government functions, corporate gatherings, social events and entertainment programmes. She is also associated with hosting large public events and programmes involving senior government representatives and prominent personalities.

The 2025 EEMA Artiste Deck lists her specialisations as government, corporate and social events. It also records her experience hosting events attended by the President and Vice President of India, the Prime Minister, chief ministers of seven states and cabinet ministers. Her portfolio includes the Bengal Global Business Meet and events for the Indian Navy.

Mitra's work has also involved celebrity appearances and entertainment-led programmes. The EEMA profile lists personalities such as Shah Rukh Khan, Arijit Singh, Sourav Ganguly, Neha Kakkar, Bipasha Basu and Kailash Kher among those she has hosted.

She is proficient in Hindi, Sanskrit, English and Bengali, according to the EEMA profile. Her professional strengths also include audience interaction, improvisation and crisis management during live programmes. Alongside hosting, Mitra has worked as an actor and trained singer. Her profile notes her association with the Satyajit Ray Film and Television Institute and a film selected for the Munich Film Festival.

Kavea R Chavali

Kavea R Chavali is an international anchor, presenter, speaker and entrepreneur whose professional journey has taken her from engineering and the technology sector to live event hosting. She studied electrical and electronics engineering at the National Institute of Technology, Warangal, before working with Bengaluru-based IT companies.

Her transition into media began with a television anchoring opportunity at TV9 in Bengaluru. She later moved into live event hosting, with her first professional emcee assignment being the Embedded Systems Conference organised by UBM India. She subsequently shifted towards full-time event hosting and built a portfolio across corporate and entertainment formats.

Chavali has hosted events across sectors including technology, banking and financial services, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, automobiles, retail, hospitality and media. Her assignments have included the Global Fintech Fest, the ICC Men's Cricket World Cup 2023 trophy unveiling at Eden Gardens and the Filmfare Awards red carpet. She has also moderated discussions on technology and women in the sector.

Her professional portfolio includes more than 1,400 shows across 15 countries and collaborations with around 800 brands. She is also associated with the handloom venture KALANECA, which works with artisans and traditional textiles. Her career combines engineering, stage presentation and entrepreneurship.

Anchor RJ Rahul Manjal

Rahul Manjal is a radio jockey, corporate anchor, emcee, television host and voice-over artist. Based in Mumbai, he has worked across corporate events, celebrity appearances, product launches, award nights, weddings, radio programmes and brand promotions. His professional website also highlights his work as a team-building facilitator and event host.

Manjal's radio experience includes associations with 93.5 Red FM, 94.3 Radio One and Radio City. He has hosted radio programmes and developed an on-ground presence through listener engagement and live activities. His experience in radio has also informed his approach to live hosting, particularly in audience interaction and spontaneous communication.

His event portfolio includes the Star Parivaar Awards red carpet, the FYI launch with author Chetan Bhagat and celebrity-led engagements featuring actors such as Shraddha Kapoor, Tiger Shroff, Shekhar Suman, Katrina Kaif, Aamir Khan and Anushka Sharma. He has also hosted corporate and brand programmes for organisations across sectors.

Manjal's work extends to voice-over assignments for advertising, corporate audio-visuals, radio spots and promotional content. At the e4m Red Carpet Experiential Marketing Awards 2025, he received the Best Male Emcee of the Year award, according to the organiser. His portfolio reflects experience across radio, corporate communication and live entertainment.

data.title: XRP ETF Outflows Hit an 8-Month High. December Rarely Brings Relief
data.description:
US spot XRP ETFs lost $19.13 million in the week ending November 13. It was their largest weekly outflow in 8 months, and it came as the altcoin fell below $1.00.

The funds have now posted 2 straight weeks of outflows. XRP has also lost 20% so far in November, CryptoRank data shows.

Past Decembers have rarely reversed a losing November.

Two Trading Days Did Most of the Damage

Most of the selling landed early in the week, SoSoValue data shows. The funds lost $10.42 million on November 9, their largest daily outflow since early March.

Another $7.62 million left on November 10. Flows then stayed flat until a $1.09 million outflow on Friday.

Only 3 weeks since spot XRP ETFs launched in November 2025 saw larger withdrawals.

Those were the weeks ending January 23, January 30, and March 13.

The XRP ETF outflows came alongside broader crypto ETF outflows, which reached $1.48 billion from November 4 to 10.

Total net assets fell 14% in a week to $1.15 billion.

Withdrawals explain only about $19 million of that $191 million drop. The falling price did most of the damage.

The $1 Line Broke. Can XRP’s $0.99 Floor Hold?

XRP price stood at $0.9947 at press time, down 14.88% over the past week, according to BeInCrypto Markets data.

XRP ended November lower in 7 of the 13 years from 2013 to 2025, according to CryptoRank. December fell in 6 of those 7 years.

data.title: Bulk of issues resolved, India-US trade pact approaching 'finishing line': Jaishankar
data.description:
India and the US have sorted out the bulk of the issues relating to the proposed trade deal, including tariff lines, and the deal could be sealed "soon" as talks continue to resolve the last stretch of concerns, External Affairs Minister S Jaishankar said on Saturday.

His remarks come a month before Prime Minister Narendra Modi's likely visit to the US for the G20 Summit, on the sidelines of which he and President Donald Trump may meet to review the broader trajectory of bilateral ties and progress on the trade pact.

In an interactive session at the HT Leadership Summit, the external affairs minister said the negotiations are approaching the "finishing line", adding that many of the remaining issues are "not so much at our end" and that more changes have occurred on the American side.

"Well, it's certainly our hope, and in many ways anticipation that we are at the last stretch. That's not a secret," he said responding to a question on the negotiations for the trade pact.

There has been speculation that India and the US may announce the trade deal following talks between Modi and Trump on the sidelines of the G20 Summit, to be held in Miami on December 14 and 15.

Jaishankar said his understanding has been that the bulk of the issues were sorted out. "There is the last stretch of issues and in many cases these concerns are not so much at our end, because the changes have been more at the American end than our end."

"The hope is that we should close it out soon. It's always the case that in that last period, everybody's impatient," he noted.

Last month, US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said in Mumbai that both sides are very close to firm up the trade deal.

India and the US have been engaged in talks since early 2025 on the proposed trade pact to address tariff friction, eliminate non-tariff barriers, and boost bilateral market access. India is seeking better tariffs than its competitors for its goods in the US market.

"For us the key is that we want a trade deal which is beneficial, it is balanced and which would give us a comparative advantage over groups of comparable economies," Jaishankar said.

"That is really what we are looking for and that is really our expectation of where we would be when the trade deal is done." he said.

The external affairs minister also called for looking at the proposed trade pact from a "larger perspective" of both countries.

"In our case, many of our early (trade) deals were done with Asian economies and many of those Asian economies were actually competitive economies. The gains which people expected from those FTAs (free trade agreements) did not exactly materialise," he said.

"Today, think if you look at the FTAs which have been done in the last few years, I think they've been much more thought through. They've been much more strategically and economically assessed," he said.

Jaishankar said the US is India's biggest market and having the trade deal with it would benefit the country.

"When you look at this big context and say there is the US, our biggest market in a way, the world's largest economy, obviously having a trade deal with such an economy would benefit us."

"For the US, President Trump is obviously looking to do a whole set of bilateral deals to improve markets for himself. Now, the challenge is to find a landing point," he said.

"I think this is not something which could have been done quickly and magically with sort of bold thinking and rapid movement, because these are very serious issues, people's jobs and people's lives are at stake."

The external affairs minister also suggested that issues relating to tariffs were sorted out.

"If you are serious, you go tariff line by tariff line. That takes time. Now we've done it the painstaking way. Not everybody has had the patience or frankly the understanding to bear with it.

"But I think having put in that effort, we have now reached almost the finishing line. I think bear with it and hopefully we'll get it," he said.

If the trade deal is finalised, then it could trigger an upswing in the overall trajectory of bilateral ties. The India-US relations witnessed a major downturn after Washington imposed punitive tariffs on India last year and President Trump made assertions regarding his role in de-escalating the India-Pakistan military clashes of May 2025 that drew sharp reaction from Indian officials.

Washington's new immigration policy and its decision to increase H1B visa fee also contributed to the slide in India-US ties.

The ties came under fresh strain after the US decided to restrict a key green-card processing programme for major global and Indian IT firms, including Tata Consultancy Services and Wipro.PTI

1. FROM MY DESK

For years, the Chinese state has been accused by Western countries of using covert operations to bolster strategic industries. Now, U.S. officials fret Beijing's spies have orchestrated a major coup: ensnaring now-former (Nvidia) Chief Executive Jensen Huang, one of the most high-profile players behind the AI boom.

China has mobilized government agencies, private companies and its citizens to undertake what Western officials say is an information-gathering campaign of unparalleled scale. Its aim is to glean technology know-how to grow China's economy and upgrade its military so that the Communist Party can tighten control at home and project power abroad.

This global effort stretches from honey traps and wide-scale hacking to investment in strategic businesses and the funding of sensitive academic research. One European intelligence agency estimates that the Chinese state has around 600,000 people working on intelligence and security matters, dwarfing anything the U.S. or European agencies can muster.

Inside Stephen Miller's frenetic first week as White House chief of staff.

Since starting his role last Friday, Miller has moved to reshape the administration's policymaking process. He has organized a marathon series of meetings with cabinet secretaries and senior advisers to the president. He began gearing up for a confrontation with Democrats on Capitol Hill, who are preparing to launch dozens of investigations into the administration. And he has already had to navigate a crisis, as an international espionage scandal widens, pitting two of President Trump's cabinet secretaries against each other. 5.

What Greece learned from going broke-and others in Europe still haven't.

The dramatic protests that recently took place in Paris, Milan and other European cities over soaring living costs and deteriorating public services looked a lot like Athens circa 2010. Much has changed since then. The Greek economy is growing faster than the European Union average, albeit from a depressed level. At a time of widening deficits and ballooning public debts, the Greek government is one of the few in the West collecting more money than it spends. It is a remarkable turnaround that required a complete rethinking of the state's approach to public finances. It also required a cultural reckoning, report Margherita Stancati and Yannis Palaiologos. Unstoppable prison gangs are transforming Ecuador into a narco state.

Criminal organizations use Ecuador's prisons as command centers for operations far beyond their concrete walls, authorities say. From inside jail cells, gangs have turned the country into a critical artery in the global cocaine trade. Once one of Latin America's most peaceful nations, Ecuador is now among its most dangerous. The quest to find the crispest apple in America.

TORONTO, ON / ACCESS Newswire / November 14, 2026 / Gabriel Resources Ltd. ("Gabriel" or the "Company") announces that the ad hoc committee (the "Annulment Committee") of the International Centre for Settlement of Investment Disputes ("ICSID") has dismissed the application by Gabriel and its wholly owned subsidiary, Gabriel Resources (Jersey) Limited ("Gabriel Jersey"), to annul the arbitral award dated March 8, 2024 (the "Award") in their proceedings against Romania (ICSID Case No. ARB/15/31) (the "Annulment Application").

The Award, which dismissed Gabriel's claims against Romania by a two-to-one majority, therefore remains in force, including the order (the "Costs Order") requiring the Company and Gabriel Jersey to pay approximately US$10 million of Romania's costs, together with interest.

The Annulment Committee rejected all five grounds on which Gabriel had sought annulment of the Award. It found that the Tribunal was properly constituted, that the arbitrator appointed by Romania was not required to disclose the matters Gabriel had raised, and that the majority of the Tribunal had applied the applicable law, respected Gabriel's procedural rights and stated adequate reasons for its decision.

The Annulment Committee directed Gabriel and Romania to share equally the fees and expenses of the Committee and ICSID, with each side bearing its own legal fees and expenses. As Gabriel had advanced the costs of the proceedings, the Committee ordered Romania to reimburse Gabriel approximately US$211,000. The Committee awarded no interest on that amount and set no payment deadline.

The decision has material implications for Gabriel's financial position and ability to continue as a going concern. The Company has limited liquidity and requires additional funding to meet its obligations, including the Costs Order and outstanding legal fees.

As of the date of this release, US$894,365 in subscription proceeds remain outstanding under the Company's US$3.4 million private placement (the "Offering"), as described in its news release dated November 9, 2026. The TSX Venture Exchange's current deadline for completing the Offering is November 16, 2026. The Company will provide a further update on the status of the Offering.

The Board is reviewing the Company's position with its legal and financial advisers. That review includes the availability of further funding, the potential value of the remaining assets and licence-related interests in Romania of the Company and its subsidiaries (collectively, the "Group"), and whether any viable restructuring or other alternative is available.

There can be no assurance that further funding or a viable alternative will be available. If no such funding or alternative is available, the Company may be required to commence proceedings under applicable insolvency legislation, in which case holders of the Company's common shares would be unlikely to receive any recovery. In light of these risks, investors are urged to exercise caution when trading in the Company's common shares. The Company will provide a further update as soon as the Board has determined the appropriate next steps.

Take-Two Interactive : Wall Street and industry analysts have set historic benchmarks for the release, fueled by Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick noting pre-orders are running "far in excess" of internal expectations. Data trackers like Sensor Tower estimated roughly 10M digital pre-orders days ahead of launch, with an unusually high concentration of buyers opting for higher-priced special editions like the $99.99 tier. Analysts project roughly $600M in profit for Take-Two from the initial launch window alone, anchoring the company's full-year FY2027 net bookings guidance of $8.0B to $8.2B, a roughly 20.5% jump over the prior year. Long-term models anticipate GTA VI’s online component eventually capturing around 60M monthly active users, pushing bullish Wall Street price targets for Take-Two into the $310 to $330 range. Bank of America expects a press release from the company within the first few days of the release if the launch stats are strong.

Sony and Microsoft : Console makers stand to earn steady, lower-risk upside from GTA 6. Sony , with roughly 98M PS5 consoles shipped, collects a standard platform cut on digital copies and in-game purchases, and could see added engagement across PlayStation Network. Microsoft earns a similar cut on Xbox Series X|S sales. GTA 6 is not part of Game Pass, but Xbox One owners can stream it by buying the game and cloud playtime, which could generate cloud-hour revenue even as it reduces the need to buy a new console. Notably, gaming console trends have improved in the last few months, and the holidays provide an opportunity for the momentum to extend.

AMD : Underneath the console hoods, AMD supplies the custom semi-custom APUs powering every single native launch console, which means a holiday hardware bundle surge could boost royalties and chip orders.

Retail: Brick-and-mortar and online retailers such as GameStop , Best Buy , Walmart (MWT), Target , and Amazon expect to see extra sales tied to gaming equipment and consoles, as rare midnight launches and high-margin accessory attach rates on controllers and headsets factor in. Also in the mix, Turtle Beach (HEAR) and Corsair could benefit, as both sell gaming peripherals such as headsets and controllers. Further down the list of beneficiaries, DoorDash and Uber Eats expect to see a short-term wave of extra demand from gamers.

Movie theater stocks: GTA 6 is expected to dominate social media feeds and streaming platforms in a development that could make it harder for studios to create viral buzz over major tentpole film releases in late November and December. Analysts also warn of a minor box office headwind for chains such as AMC Entertainment and Cinemark , with young male walk-up traffic expected to be softer than normal.

Digital content: Amazon's Twitch, Alphabet's YouTube, and Discord (DSCD) are poised to see a surge in viewership and engagement metrics, driven by creator streams and roleplay communities forming.

Logitech : Big game launches tend to spark purchases of controllers, headsets, keyboards, and other accessories. The tech company is also creating buzz by giving employees an extra day off to play a video game of their choice.

Notable ETFs focused on the video game and esports sector include the VanEck Video Gaming and eSports ETF (), the Global X Video Games & Esports ETF (), and the Roundhill Video Games ETF ().

data.title: XRP Price Today: $0.98 Support Under Threat Despite Oversold RSI
data.description:
Deeply oversold suggest a possible relief bounce, but the broader technical structure remains bearish.

The XRP price has declined approximately 4% over 24 hours, 15% over the past week, and more than 25% over the past month. The latest correction has placed the $0.98–$0.99 region under pressure, raising concerns about whether buyers can prevent another move toward $0.80.

Bears Test $0.98–$0.99 Critical Support

XRP was trading between approximately $0.982 and $0.986 on November 14, following a decline that briefly pushed the asset below $1. The weakness reflects broader pressure across the cryptocurrency market, alongside a deterioration in XRP's technical structure.

XRP failed to break $1.55 resistance, reversing from recent highs toward the channel’s lower boundary near $0.99. Source: Ali Martinez/X

In a three-day chart analysis, crypto analyst Ali Charts identified approximately $0.99 as the lower boundary of an established trading channel. XRP had previously failed to overcome resistance near $1.55 before reversing toward this level.

The analyst warned that losing $0.99 could expose the cryptocurrency to further losses toward $0.80. For an initial recovery, XRP needs to reclaim $1 and move above the $1.02 pivot region, with immediate resistance around $1.04 and $1.06.

XRP Technical Indicators Signal Strong Selling Pressure

XRP's moving averages continue to reflect a strong bearish trend. Multi-timeframe readings show the cryptocurrency trading below its short-, medium-, and long-term simple and exponential moving averages.

XRP price chart. Source: Brave New Coin

The 10-period averages are positioned around $1.08–$1.09, while the 20-period readings sit near $1.16–$1.18. Longer-term averages are considerably higher, with the 50-period indicators around $1.26–$1.32 and the 200-period readings near $1.26–$1.34.

This positioning highlights the distance XRP must recover before challenging its previous trading levels.

The Moving Average Convergence Divergence (MACD) remains negative near -0.08, with its signal line around -0.06. Its negative histogram indicates that bearish momentum has not yet produced a confirmed reversal. The Average Directional Index (ADX) also points to a relatively strong directional trend on several timeframes.

Together, these readings show that the prevailing downtrend remains established, despite signs of extreme selling conditions in shorter-term oscillators.

Oversold RSI Raises the Possibility of an XRP Rebound

The daily Relative Strength Index (RSI) is hovering around 19.8–20.8, considerably below the conventional 30 threshold for oversold conditions. Other oscillators show similar extremes, with Stochastic %K near 3–5, the Commodity Channel Index (CCI) around -130 to -143, and Williams %R near -98 to -99.

These readings indicate that XRP has experienced intense selling pressure. They also raise the possibility of short-term consolidation or a technical rebound if buyers begin entering the market.

However, oversold conditions do not guarantee a price recovery. An asset can remain in this territory during an extended downtrend, particularly when broader market sentiment remains weak.

A sustained recovery above the $1.02 pivot, accompanied by improving momentum, would provide more convincing evidence that selling pressure is easing. Until then, the RSI readings alone are insufficient to establish a bullish reversal.

Coinbase XRP Buying Activity Offers a Contrasting Signal

Despite the broader decline, exchange-flow data has revealed a potentially important development in XRP's market structure.

Crypto analyst CW8900 reported that Coinbase shifted to net XRP buying over two consecutive days after recording substantial initial selling activity that coincided with the recent price decline.

The volume of net selling on Coinbase was significantly higher than that seen on Binance or OKX during the decline. Source: @CW8900/X

The analyst's exchange-flow comparison examined price movements, trading volume, and cumulative netflow or delta readings across Coinbase, Binance, Bitfinex, and OKX.

The data highlighted significant volatility around November 13, when selling pressure and leveraged liquidations contributed to XRP's downward movement.

Coinbase's subsequent shift toward net buying is notable because the exchange had previously recorded comparatively heavy net selling. The change suggests that buying activity emerged even as XRP remained under pressure.

The analyst also highlighted whale activity and high-leverage liquidations during the decline. The resulting accumulation signals indicate that some market participants were willing to acquire XRP at lower prices despite the market's weakness.

However, net buying on a single exchange does not establish that the broader market has entered an accumulation phase. It also does not confirm that XRP has reached a price bottom.

Nevertheless, the development offers a contrasting perspective to the bearish technical indicators and suggests that buying interest has not disappeared entirely.

XRP Price Prediction: $0.75 Support and $10 Long-Term Projection

A separate monthly XRP chart analysis identifies a broader ascending channel that could influence the cryptocurrency's longer-term direction.

According to the analysis, the price remains within a rising channel, with its lower trendline serving as an important structural support. The $0.75 region is highlighted as a critical level for preserving this formation.

XRP maintains a broader ascending channel, with $0.75 serving as critical support for preserving its bullish structure; a breakdown could trigger a deeper correction. Source: TradingView

A sustained hold above $0.75 would keep the ascending-channel structure intact, while a confirmed breakdown could indicate a deeper correction and deteriorating long-term sentiment.

The monthly RSI currently stands near 41, below its neutral midpoint of 50. This indicates weakening momentum, although it does not represent the extreme oversold conditions observed on the daily timeframe. A recovery above 50 would suggest improving longer-term buying momentum.

The analyst also outlined a potential long-term upside projection toward $10, based on the channel's upper boundary. However, this remains a technical scenario rather than a confirmed price target. XRP would first need to stabilize, overcome intermediate resistance levels, and demonstrate sustained momentum improvement.

For now, the market presents conflicting signals. Bearish trend indicators point to continued pressure, while deeply oversold oscillators and Coinbase's recent buying activity suggest that a short-term recovery remains possible. The coming price action will help determine whether XRP can stabilize or extend its correction.

data.title: Bitcoin’s billion-dollar wipeouts are now a familiar sight
data.description:
Bitcoin traders are no strangers to big market swings that can decimate their portfolios in a matter of minutes. But even going by crypto standards, their wipeouts are getting bigger — and more frequent.

Large liquidation events — whereby more than $500 million worth of Bitcoin positions are obliterated in a single 24-hour session — are becoming a recurring feature in the market, as sharp swings repeatedly flush leveraged traders out of their bets. Bitcoin liquidations have topped $500 million on 13 separate occasions over the past year, including three instances when they exceeded more than $1 billion, according to Coinglass data spanning 28 futures exchanges.

The pattern repeated heading into Friday, when Bitcoin’s slide triggered the liquidation of roughly $1.3 billion in bullish crypto bets over 24 hours, with Bitcoin positions accounting for the majority of that sum.

The episodes underscore the fragility of a market already contending with ETF outflows, an AI-fueled risk-off mood that’s accelerated a downturn in various tokens and continued fallout from the recent $6 billion Binance hack, among other factors. Bitcoin has now slumped more than 20% since Oct. 21, trading as low as $66,586 in Asia on Saturday, its weakest level since August.

“These liquidations have become more prevalent over the last 12 months compared with previous periods,” said Paul Howard, senior director at the trading firm Wincent. Many crypto investors, in search of high-risk, high-reward trading, have embraced leveraged bets, where external events — including market-moving macro headlines — have caused more intense wipeouts, he added.

Derivatives account for roughly three-quarters of trading volume across crypto markets.

Bitcoin Falls Below $70,000

Alex Kuptsikevich, chief market analyst at FxPro, said that the use of derivatives have become “the norm even for investors with limited capital.” He pointed to reduced liquidity before the start of European trading hours, where a lack of institutional money means the market’s direction is less predictable. “It quite quickly reaches a point at which an avalanche of stop orders begins,” he wrote.

To be sure, some in the crypto industry cautioned against viewing large liquidation events as a signal of market fragility. “That cascade is a function of how leverage is distributed across the market, rather than a verdict on the underlying asset,” wrote Fabian Dori, chief investment officer of Sygnum Bank, noting that large liquidations have long been a characteristic of the crypto market.

Bitcoin is on pace for its sixth week lower amid a convergence of factors. Elevated oil prices and sticky inflation have reinforced expectations for additional Federal Reserve rate hikes, while Democrats retaking both chambers of the US Congress next year has raised expectations of greater regulatory scrutiny on the industry.

But another theory swirling in crypto circles is that Bitcoin is losing out in the competition for speculative capital. The selloff in artificial intelligence stocks may be creating buying opportunities that look more compelling to investors than cryptocurrencies.

That would turn a popular crypto-bull argument on its head. Just months ago, some investors expected any cooling AI rally to send speculative money toward Bitcoin. Instead, the decline in technology shares may be giving dip buyers a fresh reason to favour AI stocks over crypto.

“When Bitcoin becomes a macro asset — which it did arguably with ETFs — then it’s competing against all other macro assets for that risk crown,” said Noelle Acheson, who writes the Crypto Is Macro Now newsletter, referencing the advent of US spot-Bitcoin funds in 2024.
